## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `yarn lint`
- [ ] I ran `yarn build`

- [ ] I did **not** add unnecessary dependencies
- [ ] I removed debug logs from library code
- [ ] I did **not** hardcode example/demo values in `src/` or `android/`
- [ ] For native changes: I considered memory leaks and scroll performance
